items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Then you had Ben Webster around then. You had Chu Berry. A whole bunch of band cats, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah because they have a different style of playing and what he does, he does well, you know. He have a following in each of their field. Like Lester Young, he had a following. Coleman Hawkins had a following and they both was fantastic saxophone players. They both were stylists.
Then you had Ben Webster around then. You had Chu Berry. A whole bunch of band cats, you know.

All those people. Yeah but see now although that you had Ben Webster and Chu Berry but Coleman Hawkins and Lester Young were stylists, you see. Therefore they were more popular than Ben Webster and Chu Berry, you see.
